tools.name: inflow_list_products
tools.description: List products (SKUs) in the inFlow company, with name, SKU, category, unit of measure and tracking flags. Use this first to find productId values. GET /{companyId}/products.

tools.name: inflow_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by productId, including its costs, prices and tracking settings. GET /{companyId}/products/{productId}.

tools.name: inflow_get_product_summary
tools.description: Get stock levels for one product: quantity on hand, on order, reserved and on transfer. Optionally limit to one location. GET /{companyId}/products/{productId}/summary.

tools.name: inflow_upsert_product
tools.description: Create a product (omit productId: a new GUID is generated) or update one (pass productId). Omitted fields keep their value on update. Set timestamp from a read to block overwriting a newer edit. PUT /{companyId}/products.

tools.name: inflow_list_customers
tools.description: List customers in the inFlow company. GET /{companyId}/customers.

tools.name: inflow_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by customerId, with addresses, balances and default settings. GET /{companyId}/customers/{customerId}.

tools.name: inflow_upsert_customer
tools.description: Create a customer (omit customerId) or update one (pass customerId). Omitted fields keep their value on update. PUT /{companyId}/customers.

tools.name: inflow_list_vendors
tools.description: List vendors (suppliers) in the inFlow company. GET /{companyId}/vendors.

tools.name: inflow_get_vendor
tools.description: Get one vendor by vendorId, with addresses, balances and lead time. GET /{companyId}/vendors/{vendorId}.

tools.name: inflow_upsert_vendor
tools.description: Create a vendor (omit vendorId) or update one (pass vendorId). Omitted fields keep their value on update. PUT /{companyId}/vendors.

tools.name: inflow_list_sales_orders
tools.description: List sales orders (and quotes) in the inFlow company. GET /{companyId}/sales-orders.

tools.name: inflow_get_sales_order
tools.description: Get one sales order by salesOrderId, with its lines, payment status and shipping state. GET /{companyId}/sales-orders/{salesOrderId}.

tools.name: inflow_list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List purchase orders (and purchase quotes) in the inFlow company. GET /{companyId}/purchase-orders.

tools.name: inflow_get_purchase_order
tools.description: Get one purchase order by purchaseOrderId, with its lines, receiving and payment state. GET /{companyId}/purchase-orders/{purchaseOrderId}.

tools.name: inflow_list_locations
tools.description: List stock locations (warehouses) in the inFlow company. GET /{companyId}/locations.

tools.name: inflow_list_categories
tools.description: List product categories in the inFlow company. GET /{companyId}/categories.

tools.name: inflow_list_adjustment_reasons
tools.description: List the reasons that a stock adjustment can use (for example damage or count correction). GET /{companyId}/adjustment-reasons.

tools.name: inflow_list_stock_adjustments
tools.description: List stock adjustments (manual inventory corrections) with their lines. GET /{companyId}/stock-adjustments.

tools.name: inflow_create_stock_adjustment
tools.description: Change stock levels: add or remove quantity per product at one location, with a reason. Each line quantity is in the product's standard unit. Changes inventory at once. PUT /{companyId}/stock-adjustments.

tools.name: inflow_list_stock_transfers
tools.description: List stock transfers between locations. GET /{companyId}/stock-transfers.

tools.name: inflow_list_manufacturing_orders
tools.description: List manufacturing orders (production runs) in the inFlow company. GET /{companyId}/manufacturing-orders.
